# Property IsWindowMaximized

#### IsWindowMaximized

Tells whether the application window is maximized.

##### Declaration

```
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 7, 0, 0)]
bool IsWindowMaximized { get; }
```

##### Property Value

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  bool |   |  

##### Remarks

This property is available since v7.7.
